connector.name: prompts.chat MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Search and retrieve AI prompts from prompts.chat, the social platform for AI prompts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package prompts.chat-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the f account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROMPTS_API_KEY
env.description: API key for authenticated requests (enables save_prompt tool)

env.name: PROMPTS_QUERY
env.description: Query string to filter prompts (e.g., users=a,b&categories=c,d&tags=e,f)
